question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Couragious" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Courageous"** which means having or showing courage; brave. (साहसी)
 
• **"Courageous"** means being able to face and deal with danger or fear without flinching. (साहसी)
 
 
• **Example: **The firefighters were courageous as they rescued people from the burning building.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Couragious.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Physiologist **(शरीर विज्ञानी): A scientist who studies the functions and mechanisms occurring in living organisms.

 
 
• **Example:** The physiologist explained how the human body reacts to different types of exercise.
 
 
 
• **Gracious **(दयालु): Courteous, kind, and pleasant.
 
 
• **Example: **She was gracious enough to thank everyone for their help.
 
 
 
• **Contagious** (संक्रामक): Able to be transmitted from one person to another through direct or indirect contact.
 
 
• **Example:** The flu is highly contagious and can spread rapidly in crowded places.
